risks: only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~36% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.361), which favours a weighted combination.

Series context: trend strength 0.963 and seasonal strength 0.0541; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.361); 11 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 74.338.
